verdict.rationale: Gemini in Firebase is a built-in natural-language chat assistant in the Firebase console. It answers product questions, generates code, explains Crashlytics crashes with root causes and fix suggestions, and summarizes messaging campaigns with recommendations. The evidence shows it advising and analyzing rather than carrying out delegated actions in the project, so delegation is only partly delivered. Missing for 10: evidence the in-console assistant autonomously executes tasks (e.g., changing project resources, data, or config), multi-step agentic workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
